recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless PA later decides to alter the birth-time extension in the Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-7301 was a Published Patient change request asking to make Patient.birthDate a dateTime. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept birthDate as date to avoid timezone-related identity issues and required notes directing time-required use cases to the standard birth-time extension.
initial_application: Historical commit c68d460586 explicitly mentions tracker 7301 and added patient-birthTime guidance to the legacy Patient spreadsheet comment. Earlier issue-family work added the birthTime standard extension, and later source refactors moved the active Patient definition to source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml.
additional_context: Patient is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Patient.birthDate is type date and its comment already references the standard patient-birthTime extension for maternity and infant care. The patient-birthTime StructureDefinition is now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack, where it has a dateTime value type and contexts including Patient.birthDate, Person.birthDate, RelatedPerson.birthDate, and Practitioner.birthDate. Duplicate and related Jira issues FHIR-7605, FHIR-8507, FHIR-7478, and FHIR-3731 reinforce the same date-plus-extension design.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current core source already implements the FHIR-7301 guidance, and the extension definition belongs to the Extension Pack rather than the core checkout.
